scientific_integrity: An analytic proof establishes all-covariance CP-divisibility characterization; 518 finite numerical checks independently test the determinant, monotonicity, and finite-memory witness. No independent audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Classical centered Gaussian quadratic noise, bounded real control on a finite interval, commuting qubit pure dephasing; quantified universality is over continuous Gaussian covariances. Physical multi-time process Markovianity and quantum bath back-action are not covered.
title: Universal sign criterion for Gaussian quadratic qubit dephasing
